mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `exam_submission` (exam_id, user_id, exam_question_id, answer_content, language, status, submitted, score, result_json) VALUES (#{examId}, #{userId}, #{examQuestionId}, #{answerContent}, #{language}, #{status}, #{submitted}, #{score}, #{resultJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE `exam_submission` SET answer_content = #{answerContent}, language = #{language}, status = #{status}, submitted = 0, score = NULL, result_json = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `exam_submission` WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND exam_question_id = #{examQuestionId}
